body.message:
As of now, the extension has not been confirmed. As you know, to secure and block the apartment, advance payment is required. Since we had not received any advance payment, the unit was not blocked or reserved in advance.

Therefore, the apartment is currently available only until 7th September, as previously mentioned, and we have already shared the applicable rate with you.

If you are happy to proceed with the extension until 7th September, please let us know, and we will share the payment link to confirm and secure the extension.

Thank you for your understanding.
